entries.content:
Yordles are a race of whimsical forest creatures, they are universally small at an average of three feet tall and are also universally well natured, happy, cheerful and incapable of negative feelings such as malice or spite, they tend to be very positive and forgiving, but also universally cheeky and mischievious, with a liking for pranks and annoying schemes.

Yordles are small creatures, covered in soft, fuzzy fur, with soft smooth skins and big wide eyes that are extra emotional and cartoony, they also have long, sharp and sensitive ears.

Yordles live in Bandlewood, a magical town that can be accessed by any forest due to its innumerous portals that can lead to anywhere.
